_comment: Which delivery (audio/config.json, deliveries) each use of a recurring short line gets.
Keyed by chapter and segment order, and the use also names the speaker and text it expects,
so if a manuscript edit moves the line the use misses instead of landing on another line.
A test checks every use still lands. Uses not listed keep the original clip.
Assigned 2026-10-27 at Joshua's request: "when Jack says like No back to back, it all doesn't sound the same".
